name: Gas Malaysia Berhad
summary: Gas Malaysia Berhad sells, markets, and distributes natural gas to the industrial, commercial, and residential sectors in Malaysia. The company operates in two segments: Natural Gas & LPG, and Others. It also develops, operates, and maintains natural gas distribution system in Peninsular Malaysia; and provides management services.
